notes: Hi-res image source manifest for the hunt. These are URLs to download LOCALLY into data/images/ (analysis input only; private repo; nothing republished). license: 'CC-*' = freely reusable with attribution (safe to publish our figure of it); '(c) ...' = copyrighted, fair-use analysis only. verify_status RESOLVED = URL returned HTTP 200 image/jpeg from the sandbox on 2026-07-25. Background scouts are enriching this file (Chilbolton, Crabwood, Milk Hill, C3, etc.).
how_to_download: cd data/images && while read -r url name; do curl -L -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (research)' -o "$name" "$url"; done < <(python -c "import json;[print(s['url'],s['download_as']) for s in json.load(open('../catalog/hires_sources.json'))['sources'] if s.get('download_as')]")

sources.title: Wilton Windmill (Euler's identity)
sources.why_interesting: Reported to encode Euler's identity e^(i*pi)+1=0 in 8-bit ASCII around the ring — a genuine math/message case and a prime target for grid_analyze (B9) + an ASCII decode in forensics.encoding. NEW candidate to add to priority_formations.json.
